title: phellopterus littoralis
intro: Phellopterus littoralis, commonly known as Seaside Centaury, is a plant species in the Gentianaceae family. It is a perennial herb that grows in coastal areas and is traditionally used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Phellopterus littoralis include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can help alleviate respiratory problems and skin infections. The therapeutic actions of the plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including iridoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have antioxidant and antiseptic properties.
